purpose: Bind selected M1–M30 workbooks to typed, reviewable structural evidence without upgrading the historical audit, human-review, release, or publication state.

truthBoundary.pointerResolutionOnly: A resolved packet pointer proves only that a declared Git-tracked local teaching anchor or implementation file exists in this revision and is bound to the canonical graph/audit.
truthBoundary.humanReview: Every packet remains not-reviewed. This registry records no quality, accessibility, source-license, psychological-safety, or learner-mastery approval.
truthBoundary.publication: A structural candidate cannot change a module contract state, release evidence, route availability, strict release outcome, CI, or deployment claim.
truthBoundary.legacyAudit: Each criterion preserves the current legacy audit status. A richer pointer map never converts pointer-present or ambiguous inventory evidence into verification.

pointers.label: Recommended source set with learner links
